blocks.zh: 空氣過濾
blocks.en: Air Filtration

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 HVAC 系統中空氣過濾的四個層級（Level I ~ Terminal），以及各層級濾網的正確選型與安裝位置
blocks.en: Understand the four levels of air filtration in HVAC systems (Level I to Terminal) and the correct selection and installation location of the filters at each level

blocks.zh: 掌握 HEPA（高效微粒空氣過濾器）與非 HEPA 濾網的分類標準（ASHRAE 52.2、EN 779/1822、IEST RP-CC001）之間的對應關係
blocks.en: Understand how HEPA (High-Efficiency Particulate Air) and non-HEPA filters are classified under ASHRAE 52.2, EN 779/1822 and IEST RP-CC001, and how those classifications correspond

blocks.zh: 了解空氣過濾的物理機制——擴散、攔截、慣性碰撞、靜電沉積——以及 MPPS（最易穿透粒徑）的概念
blocks.en: Understand the physical mechanisms of air filtration (diffusion, interception, inertial impaction, electrostatic deposition) and the concept of MPPS (Most Penetrating Particle Size)

blocks.zh: 熟悉 HEPA 濾網效能議題：膠封劣化（Gel Seal Degradation）與穿透現象（Bleed-through），並掌握其預防策略
blocks.en: Become familiar with HEPA filter performance issues, namely gel seal degradation and bleed-through, and with strategies to prevent them

blocks.zh: 了解終端過濾模組（Terminal Filter Module）、Bag-in/Bag-out 外殼與風機過濾器單元（FFU）的設計與應用考量
blocks.en: Understand the design and application considerations for terminal filter modules, bag-in/bag-out housings and fan-filter units (FFUs)

blocks.zh: 5.2.2 Filter Installations（過濾器安裝）
blocks.en: 5.2.2 Filter Installations

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：壓差監控與濾網更換策略
blocks.en: Core Concept: Differential Pressure Monitoring and Filter Replacement Strategy

blocks.zh: DP Gauge（壓差計）：安裝於每組濾網兩側，用來即時監測因粉塵負載累積而增加的壓降。當壓差到達預設上限，表示濾網已接近其使用壽命，應進行更換。
blocks.en: DP gauge (differential pressure gauge): Installed across each filter bank to monitor in real time the pressure drop that builds up as dust loads the filter. When the differential pressure reaches the preset upper limit, the filter is approaching the end of its service life and should be replaced.

blocks.zh: 以壓差為基準 vs. 以時間為基準：指引明確建議以壓差為更換依據，而非僅依時間排程。「定時更換」可能造成兩種極端：太早換浪費錢，太晚換則能耗暴增、風量不足，甚至濾網爆裂（blowout）。
blocks.en: Pressure-drop-based vs. time-based replacement: The guide explicitly recommends using differential pressure, not just a time schedule, as the basis for replacement. "Scheduled replacement" can go wrong in two ways: changing too early wastes money, while changing too late causes energy consumption to soar, airflow to fall short, and even filter blowout.

blocks.zh: BAS 高壓差警報：在粉塵負載快速的環境中，可將高 DP 警報連接至樓宇自動化系統（Building Automation System），讓系統自動通知維護人員。
blocks.en: BAS high differential pressure alarm: In environments where dust loads quickly, a high DP alarm can be connected to the Building Automation System so that maintenance staff are notified automatically.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 濾網壓差監控就像汽車的機油壽命指示燈。你不會每跑 3,000 公里就換機油（太浪費），也不會等到引擎發出異響才換（太危險）。現代車輛根據實際行駛條件（溫度、轉速、距離）計算最佳更換時機——HVAC 系統的 DP 監控同理，根據實際負載狀況來決定何時更換濾網。
blocks.en: Monitoring filter differential pressure is like the oil-life indicator in a car. You would not change the oil every 3,000 km (too wasteful), nor wait until the engine starts making odd noises (too risky). A modern vehicle calculates the best time to change the oil from actual driving conditions (temperature, engine speed, distance). DP monitoring in an HVAC system works the same way: it uses the actual loading condition to decide when to change the filter.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 指引提到一個有趣的取捨：在每個濾網都裝警報可以省去巡檢人員的現場訪查，但也可能因此忽略 AHU 其他問題（如皮帶磨損、冷凝水排水不良等）。這提醒我們：自動化監控不能完全取代實地巡檢，特別是在 GMP 環境中，定期目視檢查仍然非常重要。
blocks.en: The guide points out an interesting trade-off: fitting an alarm to every filter saves operators from walking the plant to check, but it may also cause other AHU problems (such as belt wear or poor condensate drainage) to be overlooked. This is a reminder that automated monitoring cannot fully replace in-person walk-downs. In a GMP environment in particular, regular visual inspection remains very important.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前是採用「定時更換」還是「依壓差更換」濾網？哪種方式的 TCO 較低？
blocks.en: Does your site currently replace filters on a "fixed schedule" or "based on differential pressure"? Which approach gives the lower TCO?

blocks.zh: 如果 BAS 高壓差警報頻繁觸發，可能代表什麼問題？你會如何進行根因分析？
blocks.en: If the BAS high differential pressure alarm triggers frequently, what might it indicate? How would you carry out a root cause analysis?

blocks.zh: 5.2.3 Air Filter Nomenclature（空氣濾網命名與分類標準）
blocks.en: 5.2.3 Air Filter Nomenclature

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三大濾網分類標準
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Major Filter Classification Standards

blocks.zh: 全球製藥 HVAC 工程師必須理解三套不同的濾網分類系統：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical HVAC engineers worldwide need to understand three different filter classification systems:

blocks.zh: ASHRAE 52.2（美國）：使用 MERV（Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value）評級，從 MERV 1 到 MERV 16。測試基於不同粒徑範圍（E1: 0.3-1.0 μm, E2: 1.0-3.0 μm, E3: 3.0-10.0 μm）的複合平均效率。
blocks.en: ASHRAE 52.2 (US): Uses the MERV (Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value) rating, from MERV 1 to MERV 16. Testing is based on the composite average efficiency over different particle size ranges (E1: 0.3-1.0 μm, E2: 1.0-3.0 μm, E3: 3.0-10.0 μm).

blocks.zh: EN 779/1822（歐洲）：一般通風濾網用 G1-G4（粗效）、F5-F9（中效）；高效濾網用 H10-H14（HEPA，高效微粒空氣過濾器）、U15-U17（ULPA，超高效過濾器）。EN 1822 測試在 MPPS（最易穿透粒徑）下進行。
blocks.en: EN 779/1822 (Europe): For general ventilation filters, G1-G4 (coarse) and F5-F9 (medium/fine) are used; for high-efficiency filters, H10-H14 (HEPA, High-Efficiency Particulate Air) and U15-U17 (ULPA, Ultra-Low Penetration Air). EN 1822 testing is carried out at the MPPS (Most Penetrating Particle Size).

blocks.zh: IEST RP-CC001（國際）：使用字母等級（A, B, C, D, E, F, G, K），主要用於潔淨室應用。
blocks.en: IEST RP-CC001 (international): Uses letter grades (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, K), mainly for cleanroom applications.

blocks.zh: 標準之間的比較僅為近似值！由於各標準使用不同的挑戰氣膠、粒徑範圍和測試方法，對照表只能作為參考，不能視為精確等價。例如：MERV 14 大約對應 EN F8，但效率數字並非完全一致。
blocks.en: Comparisons between standards are approximate only! Because each standard uses different challenge aerosols, particle size ranges and test methods, a comparison table is a reference only and must not be treated as an exact equivalence. For example, MERV 14 corresponds roughly to EN F8, but the efficiency figures are not fully identical.

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 的實務影響：當客戶在 URS（使用者需求規格）中引用不同標準時，你必須能正確對照。歐洲客戶可能要求 H14 HEPA，美國客戶可能要求 99.995% @ 0.3 μm——這些本質上是相近的要求，但測試條件不同。
blocks.en: Practical impact for a CDMO: When clients cite different standards in the URS (User Requirements Specification), you must be able to map between them correctly. A European client may ask for an H14 HEPA, while a US client may ask for 99.995% @ 0.3 μm. These are essentially similar requirements, but the test conditions differ.

blocks.zh: 三套標準就像三種不同的考試制度評估學生能力：美國的 SAT、歐洲的 A-Level、和台灣的學測。每套考試測的核心能力相似（閱讀、數學、推理），但出題方式、計分方法和難度分布都不同。你不能直接說「SAT 1400 = A-Level AAA」，只能說它們「大約在同一個水準」。濾網標準的對照也是如此。
blocks.en: The three standards are like three different exam systems used to assess students: the SAT in the US, A-Levels in Europe, and the GSAT in Taiwan. Each tests broadly similar core abilities (reading, math, reasoning), but the question style, scoring method and difficulty distribution all differ. You cannot say directly that "SAT 1400 = A-Level AAA"; you can only say they are "at roughly the same level". The same applies when comparing filter standards.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 5.3 重點解讀：
blocks.en: Key points of Table 5.3:

blocks.zh: MERV 1-4（G1-G2）：最基本的初效過濾器（Pre-filter），對 3-10 μm 粒子效率低於 20%，主要擋大顆粒（昆蟲、植物碎片）
blocks.en: MERV 1-4 (G1-G2): The most basic pre-filters, with efficiency below 20% for 3-10 μm particles, mainly stopping large particles (insects, plant debris)

blocks.zh: MERV 7-8（G4-F5）：常見的第一道初效過濾器，是製藥 HVAC 的常用 Level I 規格
blocks.en: MERV 7-8 (G4-F5): The common first-stage pre-filter, and a commonly used Level I specification in pharmaceutical HVAC

blocks.zh: MERV 13-16（F7-F9）：高效中效濾網，0.3-1.0 μm 效率可達 75-95%，是 Level II 和 Level III 的常用規格
blocks.en: MERV 13-16 (F7-F9): High-efficiency medium filters, with 0.3-1.0 μm efficiency of 75-95%, commonly used for Level II and Level III

blocks.zh: Table 5.4 重點解讀：
blocks.en: Key points of Table 5.4:

blocks.zh: H13（99.95% @ MPPS）和 H14（99.995% @ MPPS）是製藥潔淨室最常用的 HEPA 等級
blocks.en: H13 (99.95% @ MPPS) and H14 (99.995% @ MPPS) are the HEPA grades most commonly used in pharmaceutical cleanrooms

blocks.zh: ULPA（U15-U17）效率更高，但因壓降大、成本高，在一般製藥環境較少使用
blocks.en: ULPA (U15-U17) has higher efficiency, but because of its high pressure drop and cost it is less often used in typical pharmaceutical environments

blocks.zh: EN 1822 測試在 MPPS 下進行，代表最嚴格的條件——實際環境中的效率會更高
blocks.en: EN 1822 testing is performed at the MPPS, which represents the most stringent condition; efficiency in actual use will be higher

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 AHU 中使用的初效和中效濾網分別是什麼 MERV/EN 等級？是否符合本指引的建議？
blocks.en: What MERV/EN grades are the pre-filters and medium-efficiency filters in your site's AHUs? Do they meet the recommendations of this guide?

blocks.zh: 當歐洲客戶要求「H14 HEPA」而你的供應商只提供 IEST 評級時，你如何進行等級對照？
blocks.en: When a European client asks for an "H14 HEPA" and your supplier only provides an IEST rating, how do you map the grades?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EN 1822 選擇在 MPPS 下測試，而不是在 0.3 μm？這對測試結果有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does EN 1822 test at the MPPS rather than at 0.3 μm? What effect does this have on the test results?

blocks.zh: 5.2.4 How Air Filters Work（空氣濾網的工作原理）
blocks.en: 5.2.4 How Air Filters Work

blocks.zh: 核心概念：四大粒子捕集機制
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Four Particle Capture Mechanisms

blocks.zh: 空氣濾網透過四種主要機制捕獲粒子：
blocks.en: Air filters capture particles through four main mechanisms:

blocks.zh: 擴散（Diffusion）：極小粒子（< 0.1 μm）受到氣體分子碰撞（布朗運動），路徑隨機偏移而接觸纖維被捕獲。粒子越小、風速越低，效果越好。
blocks.en: Diffusion: Very small particles (< 0.1 μm) are bombarded by gas molecules (Brownian motion), so their paths deviate randomly and they contact and are captured by fibers. The smaller the particle and the lower the air velocity, the more effective this is.

blocks.zh: 攔截（Interception）：粒子隨氣流繞過纖維時，因自身半徑太大而觸碰纖維表面。對中等粒徑（0.1-0.3 μm）最重要。
blocks.en: Interception: As particles follow the airstream around a fiber, their own radius is large enough that they touch the fiber surface. This is most important for medium particle sizes (0.1-0.3 μm).

blocks.zh: 慣性碰撞（Inertial Impaction）：較大粒子（> 0.5 μm）因慣性無法跟隨氣流轉彎，直接撞上纖維。粒子越大、風速越高，效果越好。
blocks.en: Inertial impaction: Larger particles (> 0.5 μm) cannot follow the airstream around a turn because of their inertia and hit the fiber directly. The larger the particle and the higher the air velocity, the more effective this is.

blocks.zh: 靜電沉積（Electrostatic Deposition）：帶電粒子被纖維上的相反電荷吸引。某些合成纖維濾材本身帶有靜電。
blocks.en: Electrostatic deposition: Charged particles are attracted to opposite charges on the fibers. Some synthetic filter media carry a static charge themselves.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：MPPS — 最易穿透粒徑
blocks.en: Core Concept: MPPS, the Most Penetrating Particle Size

blocks.zh: MPPS（Most Penetrating Particle Size，最易穿透粒徑）是所有 HVAC 工程師必須理解的關鍵概念。這是濾網效率最低的粒徑點，通常在 0.1-0.2 μm 範圍。
blocks.en: MPPS (Most Penetrating Particle Size) is a key concept every HVAC engineer must understand. It is the particle size at which filter efficiency is lowest, typically in the range of 0.1-0.2 μm.

blocks.zh: 為什麼存在 MPPS？因為四種捕集機制各自對不同粒徑有效：擴散對極小粒子有效，攔截和慣性碰撞對較大粒子有效。在它們的交叉點，沒有任何一種機制佔主導地位，因此總效率最低。
blocks.en: Why does an MPPS exist? Because each of the four capture mechanisms is effective for a different particle size: diffusion works for very small particles, while interception and inertial impaction work for larger particles. At the crossover point, no single mechanism dominates, so the total efficiency is at its lowest.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 EN 1822 選擇在 MPPS 下測試 HEPA 濾網——因為這是最嚴格的挑戰條件。如果濾網在 MPPS 下能達到 99.95%（H13），那麼對所有其他粒徑的效率都會更高。
blocks.en: This is why EN 1822 tests HEPA filters at the MPPS, because it is the most stringent challenge condition. If a filter achieves 99.95% at the MPPS (H13), its efficiency at every other particle size will be higher.

blocks.zh: 想像一個漁網捕魚的情境。大魚（慣性碰撞）因為太大直接卡在網上。極小的浮游生物（擴散）因為在水中隨機游動，遲早會碰到網線。但中等大小的魚（MPPS）既不會像大魚那樣直接撞上去，也不會像浮游生物那樣到處亂竄——它們剛好能跟著水流繞過網線，是最難抓的。MPPS 就是這種「最難抓的中間尺寸」。
blocks.en: Imagine catching fish with a net. Large fish (inertial impaction) are simply too big and get stuck in the net. Tiny plankton (diffusion) drift randomly in the water and sooner or later bump into the strands. But medium-sized fish (the MPPS) neither crash into the net like the big fish nor wander about like the plankton; they can follow the current around the strands, which makes them the hardest to catch. The MPPS is this "hardest-to-catch middle size".

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: Figure 5.5（捕集機制效率曲線）：這張經典圖呈現 U 型曲線。左側（小粒子）由擴散主導，效率隨粒子縮小而上升；右側（大粒子）由攔截和慣性碰撞主導，效率隨粒子增大而上升。U 型底部就是 MPPS。
blocks.en: Figure 5.5 (capture mechanism efficiency curve): This classic figure shows a U-shaped curve. On the left (small particles), diffusion dominates and efficiency rises as particles get smaller; on the right (large particles), interception and inertial impaction dominate and efficiency rises as particles get larger. The bottom of the U is the MPPS.

blocks.zh: Figure 5.6（MERV 預濾器效率）：不同 MERV 等級的初效過濾器（Pre-filter）在 MPPS 處的效率差異巨大。MERV 7 在 MPPS 可能只有 20-30%，而 MERV 16 可達 95%。注意：初效過濾器在小粒子端效率下降很快。
blocks.en: Figure 5.6 (MERV pre-filter efficiency): Pre-filters of different MERV ratings differ enormously in efficiency at the MPPS. MERV 7 may achieve only 20-30% at the MPPS, while MERV 16 can reach 95%. Note that pre-filter efficiency falls off quickly at the small-particle end.

blocks.zh: Figure 5.7（HEPA/ULPA 效率）：HEPA 濾網即使在 MPPS（約 0.1 μm）也能維持 99.97% 以上的效率，而且對更小的粒子（病毒等級，0.002 μm）效率反而更高。這是許多人的誤解——以為 HEPA 對超小粒子無效，事實恰恰相反。
blocks.en: Figure 5.7 (HEPA/ULPA efficiency): A HEPA filter maintains efficiency above 99.97% even at the MPPS (about 0.1 μm), and its efficiency is actually higher for even smaller particles (virus size, 0.002 μm). This is a common misconception: many assume HEPA is ineffective for ultra-small particles, when the opposite is true.

blocks.zh: 一個常見的誤解是：「HEPA 濾網只能過濾 0.3 μm 以上的粒子」。事實上，0.3 μm 只是美國標準測試用的挑戰粒徑，不是過濾下限。HEPA 濾網對 0.01 μm 甚至更小的粒子效率反而更高，因為布朗運動（擴散機制）在極小粒徑下非常活躍。
blocks.en: A common misconception is that "a HEPA filter can only filter particles of 0.3 μm and above". In fact, 0.3 μm is merely the challenge particle size used in US standard testing, not a lower limit of filtration. A HEPA filter is actually more efficient against particles of 0.01 μm or smaller, because Brownian motion (the diffusion mechanism) is very active at extremely small sizes.

blocks.zh: 如果你需要捕獲 0.05 μm 的病毒粒子，H13 HEPA 濾網的效率會比其 99.95% 額定值更高還是更低？為什麼？
blocks.en: If you need to capture 0.05 μm virus particles, will the efficiency of an H13 HEPA filter be higher or lower than its rated 99.95%? Why?

blocks.zh: 當風速增加時，MPPS 會向較小還是較大的粒徑方向偏移？這對濾網選型有什麼影響？
blocks.en: When air velocity increases, does the MPPS shift toward smaller or larger particle sizes? What does this mean for filter selection?

blocks.zh: 5.2.5 Filter Applications（濾網應用層級）
blocks.en: 5.2.5 Filter Applications

blocks.zh: 核心概念：四層過濾架構
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Four-Level Filtration Architecture

blocks.zh: ISPE 指引建立了清晰的四層過濾層級，每一層都有明確的功能定位：
blocks.en: The ISPE guide establishes a clear four-level filtration hierarchy, with each level having a defined functional role:

blocks.zh: Level I — 初效過濾器（Pre-filter）：MERV 7 / EN G4，擋大顆粒（蟲子、植物碎片、粗灰塵），保護 Level II 的壽命
blocks.en: Level I, pre-filter: MERV 7 / EN G4. Stops large particles (insects, plant debris, coarse dust) and protects the life of Level II

blocks.zh: Level II — 中效過濾器（Intermediate Filter）：MERV 14 / EN F8，捕獲 0.3 μm 以上粒子，保護 AHU 中的盤管和風機
blocks.en: Level II, intermediate filter: MERV 14 / EN F8. Captures particles of 0.3 μm and above and protects the coils and fans in the AHU

blocks.zh: Level III — 終效過濾器（Final Filter）：ASHRAE 型（MERV 14）或 HEPA 型（H12-H14），位於 AHU 出口，保護風管系統和下游空間
blocks.en: Level III, final filter: ASHRAE type (MERV 14) or HEPA type (H12-H14), located at the AHU outlet, protecting the ductwork and downstream spaces

blocks.zh: Terminal — 末端過濾器：H13-H14 HEPA，位於供氣端（天花板），直接保護潔淨室空間，適用於 ISO 8 以上潔淨度要求
blocks.en: Terminal filter: H13-H14 HEPA, located on the supply side (ceiling), directly protecting the cleanroom space; suited to cleanliness requirements of ISO 8 or better

blocks.zh: 四層過濾就像飲用水的多重淨化系統：
blocks.en: The four levels of filtration are like a multi-stage drinking water purification system:

blocks.zh: Level I（粗過濾）= 自來水廠的格柵，擋住石頭、樹葉等大型雜物
blocks.en: Level I (coarse filtration) = the screen at the waterworks, stopping stones, leaves and other large debris

blocks.zh: Level II（中過濾）= 沙濾池，去除較細的懸浮物和沉積物
blocks.en: Level II (medium filtration) = the sand filter bed, removing finer suspended matter and sediment

blocks.zh: Level III（細過濾）= 活性碳過濾器，去除有機物和微量化學物質
blocks.en: Level III (fine filtration) = the activated carbon filter, removing organics and trace chemicals

blocks.zh: Terminal（超精過濾）= 家用 RO 逆滲透，出水口直接飲用的最後一道防線
blocks.en: Terminal (ultra-fine filtration) = a household RO (reverse osmosis) unit, the last line of defense at the tap where you drink the water directly

blocks.zh: 每一層都在為下一層延壽並提高效率——如果拿掉初效過濾器，HEPA 濾網的壽命可能從 5 年縮短到 6 個月！
blocks.en: Each level extends the life and improves the efficiency of the next. If the pre-filter is removed, the life of a HEPA filter could drop from 5 years to 6 months!

blocks.zh: Level III HEPA 型 vs. Terminal HEPA 的選擇：
blocks.en: Choosing between Level III HEPA and Terminal HEPA:

blocks.zh: 如果只有 Level III HEPA（無 Terminal），最多能達到 Grade 8 / Grade C 潔淨度
blocks.en: With a Level III HEPA only (no Terminal), the best you can reach is Grade 8 / Grade C cleanliness

blocks.zh: 要達到 Grade 7 / Grade B 或更高，通常需要 Terminal HEPA
blocks.en: To reach Grade 7 / Grade B or better, a Terminal HEPA is normally required

blocks.zh: Level III HEPA + Terminal HEPA 的「雙重冗餘」配置可以延長昂貴的 Terminal HEPA 壽命，這在成本效益上值得考慮
blocks.en: A "double redundancy" configuration of Level III HEPA plus Terminal HEPA can extend the life of the expensive Terminal HEPA, which is worth considering on cost-effectiveness grounds

blocks.zh: 膠封（Gel Seal）要求：Terminal HEPA 必須使用矽膠膠封（silicone gel seal）確保氣密性，防止空氣從濾網周邊繞過（air bypass）。這是潔淨室完整性的關鍵環節。
blocks.en: Gel seal requirement: Terminal HEPA filters must use a silicone gel seal to ensure air tightness and prevent air bypass around the filter perimeter. This is a key element of cleanroom integrity.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：一家 CDMO 準備新建無菌充填線，設計團隊在討論是否在 AHU 內安裝 Level III HEPA（H14）作為冗餘。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: A CDMO is building a new aseptic filling line, and the design team is discussing whether to install a Level III HEPA (H14) in the AHU for redundancy.

blocks.zh: 支持意見：Terminal HEPA 更換需要停機並進行完整性測試，每次更換成本高（濾網本身 + 停機損失 + 再確效費用）。Level III HEPA 可以延長 Terminal HEPA 壽命 2-3 倍，長期來看 TCO 更低。
blocks.en: Argument in favor: Replacing a Terminal HEPA requires a shutdown and a full integrity test, so each replacement is costly (the filter itself + downtime losses + requalification cost). A Level III HEPA can extend Terminal HEPA life by 2-3 times, giving a lower TCO in the long run.

blocks.zh: 反對意見：Level III HEPA 增加系統壓降約 1 英寸水柱，風機能耗增加。且 HEPA 濾網的維護比 ASHRAE 濾網複雜。
blocks.en: Argument against: A Level III HEPA adds about 1 inch w.g. of system pressure drop and increases fan energy consumption. HEPA filter maintenance is also more complex than for ASHRAE filters.

blocks.zh: 建議策略：對於高價值產品的 Grade A/B 區域，冗餘 HEPA 幾乎是必要的。對於 Grade C/D 區域，進行 TCO 分析後再決定。
blocks.en: Recommended strategy: For Grade A/B areas handling high-value products, redundant HEPA is almost essential. For Grade C/D areas, decide after performing a TCO analysis.

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠中，各潔淨度等級區域分別使用了幾層過濾？是否符合 ISPE 的四層建議？
blocks.en: In your site, how many levels of filtration are used in each cleanliness grade area? Does this meet ISPE's four-level recommendation?

blocks.zh: Terminal HEPA 濾網被安裝在回風管路上時，為什麼會影響房間壓差控制？你會如何因應？
blocks.en: Why would installing a Terminal HEPA filter on a return air duct affect room pressure differential control? How would you deal with it?

blocks.zh: Level III 使用 H12（99.5%）和 H14（99.995%）的差別在實際環境中有多大影響？如何量化？
blocks.en: How much real-world difference is there between using H12 (99.5%) and H14 (99.995%) at Level III? How would you quantify it?

blocks.zh: 5.2.5.4 Terminal Filtration — Modules, Bag-in/Bag-out & FFU（終端過濾模組、密封更換外殼與風機過濾單元）
blocks.en: 5.2.5.4 Terminal Filtration: Modules, Bag-in/Bag-out & FFU

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三種終端過濾設備
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Types of Terminal Filtration Equipment

blocks.zh: 1. Terminal Air Filter Module（終端過濾模組）：安裝於天花板的 HEPA 過濾器外殼，是潔淨室供氣的最後一道防線。單濾網模組用於一般潔淨室；多濾網的 Plenum Module（壓力箱模組）則用於需要單向氣流的 Grade A/Grade 5 區域。
blocks.en: 1. Terminal Air Filter Module: A ceiling-mounted HEPA filter housing, the last line of defense for cleanroom supply air. Single-filter modules are used in general cleanrooms; multi-filter plenum modules are used in Grade A/Grade 5 areas that require unidirectional airflow.

blocks.zh: 2. Bag-in/Bag-out (BIBO) Housing（袋進袋出外殼）：專為危險物質設計的側面維修型濾網外殼。使用塑膠袋密封技術，讓維護人員可以在不接觸汙染濾網的情況下更換 HEPA 濾網。用於生物危害、放射性、細胞毒性或致癌物質的排氣處理。
blocks.en: 2. Bag-in/Bag-out (BIBO) Housing: A side-service filter housing designed for hazardous materials. It uses a plastic bag sealing technique so that maintenance staff can change HEPA filters without coming into contact with the contaminated filter. It is used for exhaust treatment of biohazardous, radioactive, cytotoxic or carcinogenic materials.

blocks.zh: 3. FFU — Fan-Filter Unit（風機過濾器單元）：自帶風機的獨立 HEPA 過濾裝置，可靈活部署。適合小區域保護（取樣點、人孔等）、增加潔淨室空氣交換次數，或作為老舊設施的改裝方案。
blocks.en: 3. FFU (Fan-Filter Unit): A self-contained HEPA filtration device with its own fan, which can be deployed flexibly. It suits protection of small areas (sampling points, manholes, etc.), increasing the air change rate of a cleanroom, or serving as a retrofit solution for older facilities.

blocks.zh: Terminal Module 就像中央空調出風口——固定安裝、由大系統供氣。FFU 則像可攜式空氣清淨機——自帶風機，插電即用，可以隨時移動到需要的地方。BIBO Housing 則像醫院的負壓隔離病房排氣口——必須確保任何時候都不會讓危險物質外洩，連換濾網的過程都要完全密封。
blocks.en: A Terminal Module is like a central air-conditioning outlet: fixed in place and supplied by the larger system. An FFU is like a portable air purifier: it has its own fan, works when plugged in, and can be moved wherever needed. A BIBO Housing is like the exhaust outlet of a negative-pressure isolation ward in a hospital: it must ensure hazardous material never escapes at any time, so even the filter change is fully sealed.

blocks.zh: Pinhole Scan 測試的注意事項：
blocks.en: Points to note for pinhole scan testing:

blocks.zh: UDAF（單向氣流）罩和危險物質捕集器的 HEPA 濾網需要 100% 面積的 Leak Test（洩漏測試），穿透率不得超過 0.01%
blocks.en: HEPA filters in UDAF (unidirectional airflow) hoods and hazardous-material containment units require a 100% area Leak Test, with penetration not exceeding 0.01%

blocks.zh: 使用油性氣膠（DOP Test 或 PAO）測試時，油會被濾材吸收。測試應盡可能簡短，上游濃度保持在光度計靈敏度範圍的低端
blocks.en: When testing with oil-based aerosols (DOP test or PAO), the oil is absorbed by the filter media. The test should be as brief as possible, and the upstream concentration kept at the low end of the photometer's sensitivity range

blocks.zh: 測試後需要讓濾網「乾燥」，讓吸收的油蒸發。如果濾材被過度「濕潤」，會影響其過濾性能
blocks.en: After testing, the filter needs to be allowed to "dry" so that the absorbed oil evaporates. If the media becomes excessively "wet", its filtration performance will be affected

blocks.zh: FFU 的局限性：雖然多個 FFU 理論上可以組合成 Grade 5 層流罩，但實際上很少這樣做，因為難以保證整體氣流模式的一致性。FFU 更適合作為輔助或應急方案。
blocks.en: Limitations of FFUs: Although multiple FFUs could in theory be combined into a Grade 5 laminar flow hood, this is rarely done in practice because it is difficult to guarantee a consistent overall airflow pattern. FFUs are better suited as a supplementary or emergency solution.

blocks.zh: CDMO 改裝場景：一家 CDMO 的更衣室是 20 年前的設計，通風不良，微粒計數（Particle Count）經常不達標。完整改建 HVAC 系統需要停機 3 個月。
blocks.en: CDMO retrofit scenario: A CDMO's gowning room was designed 20 years ago, has poor ventilation, and its particle counts frequently fail to meet the limits. A full HVAC rebuild would require a 3-month shutdown.

blocks.zh: FFU 快速解決方案：
blocks.en: The quick FFU solution:

blocks.zh: 在更衣室牆壁安裝 2 台不鏽鋼 FFU，從地面抽氣、從天花板送出 HEPA 過濾空氣
blocks.en: Install 2 stainless steel FFUs on the gowning room wall, drawing air from floor level and delivering HEPA-filtered air from the ceiling

blocks.zh: 增加約 20 次/小時的換氣量
blocks.en: Adds about 20 air changes per hour

blocks.zh: 安裝時間：1-2 天，不需要停止生產
blocks.en: Installation time: 1-2 days, with no need to stop production

blocks.zh: 成本：約 HVAC 改建費用的 1/10
blocks.en: Cost: about 1/10 of the HVAC rebuild cost

blocks.zh: 這正是指引提到的「retrofit for small rooms needing HEPA filtered airflow」的典型應用。
blocks.en: This is a typical application of what the guide describes as a "retrofit for small rooms needing HEPA filtered airflow".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Room Side Replacement
blocks.en: Key Note: Room Side Replacement

blocks.zh: 指引強調 Terminal Module 應設計為室內側更換（room side filter replacement）。這很重要，因為：
blocks.en: The guide stresses that a Terminal Module should be designed for room side filter replacement. This matters because:

blocks.zh: 避免在天花板上方（技術夾層）進行維護，該區域通常是非潔淨區
blocks.en: It avoids maintenance above the ceiling (the technical interstitial space), which is usually a non-cleanroom area

blocks.zh: 更換過程可以在受控環境下進行，降低污染風險
blocks.en: The replacement can be performed in a controlled environment, reducing contamination risk

blocks.zh: 便於 QA 人員觀察和記錄更換過程
blocks.en: It makes it easier for QA personnel to observe and record the replacement

blocks.zh: 例外情況：一次性拋棄型天花板嵌入式濾網，因為整個模組連同濾網一起從上方取出替換。
blocks.en: Exception: disposable ceiling-recessed filters, where the entire module is removed from above and replaced together with the filter.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠有使用 Bag-in/Bag-out 外殼嗎？如果處理高活性 API（HPAPI），排氣系統的過濾設計應如何升級？
blocks.en: Does your site use Bag-in/Bag-out housings? If you handle highly potent APIs (HPAPI), how should the filtration design of the exhaust system be upgraded?

blocks.zh: FFU 的「自帶風機」特性在什麼場景下是優勢？什麼場景下反而是劣勢？
blocks.en: In which scenarios is the FFU's "self-contained fan" an advantage, and in which is it a disadvantage?

blocks.zh: 如果 pinhole scan 發現 HEPA 濾網有局部穿透超過 0.01%，你的 SOP 會如何處理？
blocks.en: If a pinhole scan finds local penetration above 0.01% on a HEPA filter, how would your SOP handle it?

blocks.zh: 5.2.6 Airborne Particle Sizes（空氣中的微粒尺寸）
blocks.en: 5.2.6 Airborne Particle Sizes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：粒子世界的二八法則
blocks.en: Core Concept: The 80/20 Rule of the Particle World

blocks.zh: 這段內容揭示了一個令人驚訝的事實：
blocks.en: This section reveals a surprising fact:

blocks.zh: 90% 的粒子數量集中在 0.5 μm 以下 → 但它們只佔 < 1% 的質量
blocks.en: 90% of particles by number are below 0.5 μm, but they make up < 1% of the mass

blocks.zh: 不到 2% 的粒子數量在 1 μm 以上 → 卻佔了 97% 的質量
blocks.en: Fewer than 2% of particles by number are above 1 μm, but they make up 97% of the mass

blocks.zh: 這意味著：初效過濾器（Pre-filter）雖然效率「低」，但承擔了絕大部分的質量負載。如果沒有初效過濾器，大量灰塵會直接衝擊 HEPA 濾網，大幅縮短其壽命。
blocks.en: This means that although a pre-filter has "low" efficiency, it carries the vast majority of the mass load. Without a pre-filter, large quantities of dust would hit the HEPA filter directly and greatly shorten its life.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Viable vs. Non-viable Particles
blocks.en: Core Concept: Viable vs. Non-viable Particles

blocks.zh: Viable Particles（活性微粒）——病毒、細菌、孢子——在總微粒中只是極小的比例。在室外空氣中每立方英尺約有 100 萬個總微粒，但只有幾百到幾千個活性微粒。
blocks.en: Viable particles (viruses, bacteria, spores) make up only a tiny fraction of total particles. Outdoor air contains about 1 million total particles per cubic foot, but only a few hundred to a few thousand viable particles.

blocks.zh: 這是為什麼 Particle Count（微粒計數）可以作為微生物污染的間接指標：如果能控制總微粒到極低水平，活性微粒自然也會被大幅減少。但反過來不一定成立——微粒計數合格不等於微生物計數一定合格。
blocks.en: This is why Particle Count can serve as an indirect indicator of microbial contamination: if total particles are controlled to a very low level, viable particles will naturally be greatly reduced as well. The reverse is not necessarily true, however: passing the particle count does not guarantee passing the microbial count.

blocks.zh: 想像一場大型音樂節的人群：90% 的人（相當於亞微米粒子）都是瘦小的觀眾，加起來佔不了多少空間；但那 2% 的大型器材搬運車和舞台設備（相當於大粒子）卻佔了 97% 的場地面積。初效過濾器就像入口處的寬大閘門，主要擋住大型車輛；HEPA 則是最後的人員安檢門，確保每一個人都經過仔細檢查。
blocks.en: Imagine the crowd at a large music festival: 90% of the people (equivalent to submicron particles) are slight spectators who together take up little space, but the 2% made up of large equipment trucks and stage gear (equivalent to large particles) take up 97% of the floor area. The pre-filter is like the wide entrance gate that mainly stops large vehicles, while the HEPA is the final security checkpoint that makes sure every single person is carefully screened.

blocks.zh: 數據整理 Particle Size Reference
blocks.en: Particle Size Reference

blocks.zh:
微粒類型              尺寸範圍          製藥關注度
─────────────────────────────────────────────
病毒 (Viruses)       0.002 – 0.05 µm   ★★★★★
細菌 (Bacteria)      0.4 – 20 µm       ★★★★★
植物孢子 (Spores)    10 – 40 µm        ★★★
煙霧 (Smoke)         0.01 – 1 µm       ★★
測試氣膠 (DOP/PAO)   0.1 – 0.7 µm      (測試用)
灰塵 (Dust/Ash)      0.5 – 1000 µm     ★★

HEPA MPPS 範圍：0.1 – 0.3 µm
→ 所有 viable particles 的捕獲效率 > MPPS 額定值
blocks.en:
Particle type          Size range        Pharma relevance
─────────────────────────────────────────────
Viruses              0.002 – 0.05 µm   ★★★★★
Bacteria             0.4 – 20 µm       ★★★★★
Plant spores         10 – 40 µm        ★★★
Smoke                0.01 – 1 µm       ★★
Test aerosol (DOP/PAO)   0.1 – 0.7 µm      (for testing)
Dust/Ash             0.5 – 1000 µm     ★★

HEPA MPPS range: 0.1 – 0.3 µm
→ Capture efficiency for all viable particles > the MPPS rating

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：指引最後一句話非常重要——「A filter with an MPPS of 0.1 to 0.3 microns should perform well against viable particles, capturing them at efficiencies greater than its rating at MPPS.」
blocks.en: Key insight: The last sentence of the guide is very important: "A filter with an MPPS of 0.1 to 0.3 microns should perform well against viable particles, capturing them at efficiencies greater than its rating at MPPS."

blocks.zh: 這意味著：HEPA 濾網的 MPPS 額定效率（如 H13 的 99.95%）是最差情況的效率。對於細菌（0.4-20 μm）和病毒（0.002-0.05 μm），實際捕獲效率都比額定值更高。這讓我們對 HEPA 過濾在無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）中的角色更有信心。
blocks.en: This means that the MPPS rated efficiency of a HEPA filter (such as 99.95% for H13) is the worst-case efficiency. For bacteria (0.4-20 μm) and viruses (0.002-0.05 μm), the actual capture efficiency is higher than the rated value. This gives us greater confidence in the role of HEPA filtration in sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 如果你需要向法規稽核員解釋「為什麼 HEPA 濾網對病毒有效」，你會如何用 MPPS 的概念來說明？
blocks.en: If you had to explain to a regulatory inspector "why a HEPA filter is effective against viruses", how would you explain it using the concept of MPPS?

blocks.zh: 為什麼初效過濾器的「效率」數字看起來很低（如 MERV 7 只有約 50-70% @ 3-10 μm），但它對整個系統的貢獻卻非常大？
blocks.en: Why do the "efficiency" figures of a pre-filter look so low (e.g. MERV 7 at only about 50-70% @ 3-10 μm), yet its contribution to the whole system is so large?

blocks.zh: 5.2.7 HEPA Filter Performance Issues（HEPA 濾網效能議題）
blocks.en: 5.2.7 HEPA Filter Performance Issues

blocks.zh: 核心概念：膠封劣化的機理
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Mechanism of Gel Seal Degradation

blocks.zh: Gel Seal Degradation（膠封劣化）是製藥潔淨室中最令人頭痛的 HEPA 維護問題之一。其根因是矽膠（silicone/siloxane）中未完全交聯的聚合物成分從膠體基質中遷移出來，形成表面的黏滑液體。
blocks.en: Gel Seal Degradation is one of the most troublesome HEPA maintenance problems in pharmaceutical cleanrooms. The root cause is that incompletely cross-linked polymer components in the silicone (siloxane) migrate out of the gel matrix and form a sticky, slippery liquid on the surface.

blocks.zh: 關鍵影響因子：
blocks.en: Key influencing factors:

blocks.zh: 交聯程度：交聯越完全，未鍵結聚合物越少，遷移風險越低。混合比例、環境溫度、反應時間都會影響交聯品質。
blocks.en: Degree of cross-linking: The more complete the cross-linking, the less unbonded polymer there is and the lower the migration risk. Mixing ratio, ambient temperature and reaction time all affect cross-link quality.

blocks.zh: 分子量：高分子量的膠封材料擴散和遷移速度更慢，窄分布更理想。
blocks.en: Molecular weight: Gel seal materials of higher molecular weight diffuse and migrate more slowly, and a narrow distribution is preferable.

blocks.zh: DOP/PAO 測試氣膠：這些油性氣膠會作為溶劑，加速未鍵結聚合物的遷移——諷刺的是，為了驗證 Filter Integrity（過濾器完整性）而進行的測試本身，反而會加速膠封劣化！
blocks.en: DOP/PAO test aerosols: These oil-based aerosols act as solvents and accelerate the migration of unbonded polymer. Ironically, the very test performed to verify Filter Integrity itself accelerates gel seal degradation!

blocks.zh: 膠封劣化就像巧克力放太久出現的「白霜」現象（fat bloom）。巧克力中的可可脂如果沒有被良好的結晶（類似於不完全交聯），會隨時間慢慢遷移到表面形成白色薄膜。巧克力還是可以吃（濾網完整性測試可能還是通過），但外觀和質感已經劣化（衛生和外觀問題）。而且，如果巧克力暴露在溫暖環境中（類似 DOP/PAO 氣膠的溶劑效應），白霜會出現得更快。
blocks.en: Gel seal degradation is like the "white bloom" (fat bloom) on chocolate stored too long. If the cocoa butter in the chocolate has not crystallized well (similar to incomplete cross-linking), it slowly migrates to the surface over time and forms a white film. The chocolate can still be eaten (the filter integrity test may still pass), but its appearance and texture have deteriorated (a hygiene and appearance issue). And if the chocolate is exposed to a warm environment (similar to the solvent effect of DOP/PAO aerosol), the bloom appears even faster.

blocks.zh: 三個關鍵警告：
blocks.en: Three key warnings:

blocks.zh: 不要用矽膠填縫劑修補膠封軌道的接縫！因為膠封成分會穿透矽膠填縫劑（silicone gel components will penetrate silicone caulk）。必須使用經過驗證的、對矽膠成分不滲透的材料。
blocks.en: Do not use silicone caulk to repair the seams of the gel seal track! The gel seal components will penetrate silicone caulk (silicone gel components will penetrate silicone caulk). A qualified material that is impermeable to the silicone components must be used.

blocks.zh: 不要用聚氨酯膠（urethane gel）取代矽膠！聚氨酯膠對清潔消毒劑敏感，而且是親水性材料，高濕環境會影響固化品質。
blocks.en: Do not substitute urethane gel for silicone! Urethane gel is sensitive to cleaning and disinfecting agents, and it is hydrophilic, so a high-humidity environment will affect cure quality.

blocks.zh: 減少 DOP/PAO 暴露量：每次完整性測試都會加速膠封劣化。因此測試應該簡短高效——一次只測一個濾網，上游氣膠濃度保持在最低有效範圍。
blocks.en: Reduce DOP/PAO exposure: Every integrity test accelerates gel seal degradation. Tests should therefore be brief and efficient: test one filter at a time and keep the upstream aerosol concentration at the lowest effective range.

blocks.zh: 場景：工廠維護人員在例行巡檢中發現 Grade B 區域天花板的 HEPA 濾網膠封出現半透明滲液，並滴落到下方地板。
blocks.en: Scenario: During a routine walk-down, plant maintenance staff find translucent fluid seeping from the gel seal of a HEPA filter in the ceiling of a Grade B area and dripping onto the floor below.

blocks.zh: 你應該如何處理？
blocks.en: How should you handle it?

blocks.zh: 即時處置：啟動偏差調查（Deviation Investigation）、增加環境監測頻率、評估是否需要臨時停產
blocks.en: Immediate action: Initiate a deviation investigation, increase the frequency of environmental monitoring, and assess whether a temporary production stop is needed

blocks.zh: 根因分析：檢查膠封供應商批次、確認混合比例記錄、調查近期 DOP 測試頻率和濃度
blocks.en: Root cause analysis: Check the gel seal supplier's batch, confirm the mixing ratio records, and investigate the recent DOP test frequency and concentration

blocks.zh: 矯正措施：更換為高交聯度矽膠封的新 HEPA 濾網、與供應商合作確認最佳膠封規格、調整完整性測試 SOP（降低氣膠濃度、縮短測試時間）
blocks.en: Corrective action: Replace with new HEPA filters that have a highly cross-linked silicone gel seal, work with the supplier to confirm the best gel seal specification, and adjust the integrity test SOP (lower aerosol concentration, shorter test time)

blocks.zh: 預防措施：建立膠封外觀巡檢 SOP、將膠封供應商規格納入變更管制
blocks.en: Preventive action: Establish an SOP for visual inspection of the gel seal, and bring the gel seal supplier specification under change control

blocks.zh: 你的工廠多久進行一次 HEPA 完整性測試？每次測試使用的 DOP/PAO 濃度是多少？是否可以優化以減少對膠封的損害？
blocks.en: How often does your site perform HEPA integrity tests? What DOP/PAO concentration is used in each test? Can it be optimized to reduce damage to the gel seal?

blocks.zh: 如果膠封劣化沒有導致完整性測試失敗，是否還需要更換濾網？從 GMP 的角度如何判斷？
blocks.en: If gel seal degradation has not caused an integrity test failure, does the filter still need to be replaced? How would you decide from a GMP perspective?

blocks.zh: 5.2.7.2 HEPA Filter Bleed-through（HEPA 濾網穿透現象）
blocks.en: 5.2.7.2 HEPA Filter Bleed-through

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Bleed-through 的根因
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Root Cause of Bleed-through

blocks.zh: Bleed-through（穿透現象）不是濾網有破洞或裂縫（那叫 pinhole leak），而是整個濾面均勻地呈現過高的穿透率。這是一個系統性問題，根因在於工廠測試條件與現場測試條件不匹配。
blocks.en: Bleed-through is not a hole or crack in the filter (that is a pinhole leak). Instead, the entire filter face shows uniformly high penetration. This is a systemic problem whose root cause is a mismatch between factory test conditions and field test conditions.

blocks.zh: 兩個關鍵因素：
blocks.en: Two key factors:

blocks.zh: 氣膠產生器類型：Laskin-nozzle（氣動式）產生的粒子較大（MMD 0.5-0.7 μm），Hot-block（熱塊式）產生的粒子較小（MMD 0.2-0.3 μm）。如果工廠用 Laskin-nozzle 測試通過，現場用 Hot-block 測試可能失敗，因為 Hot-block 產生的粒子更接近 MPPS。
blocks.en: Type of aerosol generator: A Laskin-nozzle (pneumatic) generator produces larger particles (MMD 0.5-0.7 μm), while a hot-block (thermal) generator produces smaller particles (MMD 0.2-0.3 μm). If a filter passes the factory test with a Laskin-nozzle, it may fail in the field with a hot-block, because the hot-block particles are closer to the MPPS.

blocks.zh: 風速差異：風速增加會降低效率並使 MPPS 向更小粒徑偏移。工廠在 100 fpm 測試通過，現場 150 fpm 可能失敗。
blocks.en: Difference in air velocity: Increasing air velocity lowers efficiency and shifts the MPPS toward smaller particle sizes. A filter that passes at 100 fpm at the factory may fail at 150 fpm in the field.

blocks.zh: Bleed-through 就像一輛車在平坦賽道（工廠測試條件）上的煞車測試完美通過，但到了真實山路（現場條件）就煞不住。不是煞車壞了，而是測試條件不能代表實際使用環境。賽道上速度較低（Laskin-nozzle 的較大粒子）、路面乾淨；山路上速度更高（hot-block 的更小粒子、更高風速）、彎道更急（更接近 MPPS 的挑戰）。
blocks.en: Bleed-through is like a car that passes its brake test perfectly on a flat test track (factory test conditions) but cannot stop on a real mountain road (field conditions). The brakes are not broken; the test conditions simply do not represent the actual operating environment. On the track the speed is lower (the larger particles of a Laskin-nozzle) and the road is clean; on the mountain road the speed is higher (the smaller particles and higher air velocity of a hot-block) and the bends are sharper (a challenge closer to the MPPS).

blocks.zh: 解決方案很簡單：要求供應商在接近實際使用條件的環境下測試。
blocks.en: The solution is simple: require the supplier to test under conditions close to actual use.

blocks.zh: 避免 Bleed-through 的三大策略：
blocks.en: Three key strategies to avoid bleed-through:

blocks.zh: 指定濾網效率在 MPPS 下的表現，而非在 0.3 μm 下。例如指定「H14: 99.995% @ MPPS」而非「99.995% @ 0.3 μm」。這確保濾網在最嚴格條件下仍符合要求。
blocks.en: Specify filter efficiency at the MPPS, not at 0.3 μm. For example, specify "H14: 99.995% @ MPPS" rather than "99.995% @ 0.3 μm". This ensures the filter still meets the requirement under the most stringent conditions.

blocks.zh: 告知供應商現場測試方法：讓供應商知道你將使用 hot-block 還是 Laskin-nozzle 產生器，以便提供適配的濾材等級。
blocks.en: Tell the supplier the field test method: Let the supplier know whether you will use a hot-block or a Laskin-nozzle generator, so that they can supply a suitable media grade.

blocks.zh: 指定面風速（face velocity）：確保工廠測試的風速不低於現場實際風速。如果設計風速為 90 fpm，工廠至少應在 90-100 fpm 下測試。
blocks.en: Specify the face velocity: Ensure the air velocity used in factory testing is no lower than the actual field velocity. If the design velocity is 90 fpm, the factory should test at no less than 90-100 fpm.

blocks.zh: 對照整理：兩種氣膠產生器
blocks.en: Comparison: Two Aerosol Generators

blocks.zh:
產生器類型          粒徑 (MMD)      與 MPPS 的關係        穿透風險
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Laskin-nozzle      0.5 – 0.7 µm   遠大於 MPPS (0.12-0.25)  低
(氣動式)                           → 濾網效率較高

Hot-block          0.2 – 0.3 µm   接近 MPPS              高
(熱塊式)                           → 濾網效率處於最低點

HEPA 實際 MPPS：0.12 – 0.25 µm（非標準標示的 0.3 µm）
blocks.en:
Generator type     Particle size (MMD)   Relationship to MPPS      Bleed-through risk
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Laskin-nozzle      0.5 – 0.7 µm   Much larger than MPPS (0.12-0.25)  Low
(pneumatic)                           → filter efficiency is higher

Hot-block          0.2 – 0.3 µm   Close to MPPS              High
(thermal)                           → filter efficiency is at its lowest point

Actual HEPA MPPS: 0.12 – 0.25 µm (not the 0.3 µm commonly quoted as standard)

blocks.zh: Figure 5.8（風速對效率的影響）：隨著風速增加，效率曲線的 MPPS 谷底變得更深（效率更低）且向左偏移（MPPS 變小）。這雙重效應使得高風速下的 bleed-through 風險大增。
blocks.en: Figure 5.8 (effect of air velocity on efficiency): As air velocity increases, the MPPS trough of the efficiency curve becomes deeper (lower efficiency) and shifts to the left (smaller MPPS). This double effect greatly increases the bleed-through risk at high air velocity.

blocks.zh: 指引還提到一個重要細節：濾材的介質風速（media velocity）遠低於面風速（face velocity），因為 HEPA 濾材有大量褶摺，增加了有效過濾面積。例如面風速 100 fpm 時，介質風速可能只有 3-5 fpm。
blocks.en: The guide also mentions an important detail: the media velocity of the filter media is far lower than the face velocity, because HEPA media is heavily pleated, which increases the effective filtration area. For example, at a face velocity of 100 fpm, the media velocity may be only 3-5 fpm.

blocks.zh: 場景：你的 QC 團隊使用 hot-block 產生器對新安裝的 HEPA 濾網進行完整性測試，結果 3 片新濾網中有 2 片未通過——但供應商提供的工廠測試證書顯示全部通過。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your QC team uses a hot-block generator to perform integrity tests on newly installed HEPA filters, and 2 of the 3 new filters fail, yet the factory test certificates from the supplier show that all of them passed.

blocks.zh: 分析與處理：
blocks.en: Analysis and handling:

blocks.zh: 第一步：確認現場測試的氣膠產生器類型和上游濃度。如果使用 hot-block，其粒徑分布可能與供應商的 Laskin-nozzle 測試有顯著差異。
blocks.en: Step 1: Confirm the aerosol generator type and upstream concentration used in the field test. If a hot-block was used, its particle size distribution may differ significantly from the supplier's Laskin-nozzle test.

blocks.zh: 第二步：確認現場測試風速與供應商工廠測試風速是否一致。
blocks.en: Step 2: Confirm whether the field test air velocity matches the air velocity of the supplier's factory test.

blocks.zh: 第三步：與供應商溝通，要求：(a) 提供在 hot-block 條件下的測試數據，(b) 提供 MPPS 效率數據而非僅 0.3 μm 效率，(c) 如果必要，升級至更高等級的濾材。
blocks.en: Step 3: Communicate with the supplier and request: (a) test data under hot-block conditions, (b) MPPS efficiency data rather than only 0.3 μm efficiency, and (c) if necessary, an upgrade to a higher media grade.

blocks.zh: 長期矯正：更新 URS/採購規格，明確要求濾網效率以 MPPS 為基準，並指定現場測試方法。
blocks.en: Long-term corrective action: Update the URS/purchasing specification to state clearly that filter efficiency is based on the MPPS, and specify the field test method.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠使用哪種類型的氣膠產生器？供應商的工廠測試又使用哪種？兩者是否一致？
blocks.en: What type of aerosol generator does your site use? What does the supplier use for factory testing? Are the two consistent?

blocks.zh: 如果將所有 HEPA 規格改為「效率 @ MPPS」而非「效率 @ 0.3 μm」，對採購成本和供應商選擇會有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If all HEPA specifications were changed to "efficiency @ MPPS" instead of "efficiency @ 0.3 μm", what would be the effect on purchasing cost and supplier selection?

blocks.zh: Bleed-through 只出現在 HEPA 而非 ULPA 濾網上，這與 ULPA 濾材的結構有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Bleed-through occurs only in HEPA and not in ULPA filters. How does this relate to the structure of ULPA media?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 壓差監控優於定時更換：以 DP gauge 監測濾網負載，依據壓差而非時間排程來決定更換時機，可降低 TCO 並避免 blowout 風險
blocks.en: Differential pressure monitoring is better than scheduled replacement: Monitor filter loading with a DP gauge and decide when to replace based on differential pressure rather than a time schedule; this lowers TCO and avoids the risk of blowout

blocks.zh: 三大標準需要能互相對照：ASHRAE 52.2（MERV）、EN 779/1822（G/F/H/U）、IEST RP-CC001（A-G/K）三套分類標準各有不同測試方法，比較僅為近似值
blocks.en: The three major standards must be cross-referenced: ASHRAE 52.2 (MERV), EN 779/1822 (G/F/H/U) and IEST RP-CC001 (A-G/K) are three classification standards with different test methods, and comparisons are approximate only

blocks.zh: MPPS 是濾網效率的最低點：位於 0.1-0.2 μm 範圍，是擴散、攔截、慣性碰撞三種機制效力交叉的「盲區」。EN 1822 選擇在 MPPS 下測試，代表最嚴格的挑戰
blocks.en: The MPPS is the lowest point of filter efficiency: It lies in the 0.1-0.2 μm range and is the "blind spot" where the effectiveness of diffusion, interception and inertial impaction crosses over. EN 1822 tests at the MPPS, which represents the most stringent challenge

blocks.zh: 四層過濾架構各司其職：Level I（MERV 7/G4）擋大粒子延壽、Level II（MERV 14/F8）保護設備、Level III（HEPA 或 ASHRAE）保護風管、Terminal（H13-H14）保護潔淨室
blocks.en: Each of the four filtration levels has its own role: Level I (MERV 7/G4) stops large particles and extends filter life, Level II (MERV 14/F8) protects equipment, Level III (HEPA or ASHRAE) protects the ductwork, and Terminal (H13-H14) protects the cleanroom

blocks.zh: FFU 是靈活的補充方案：自帶風機的獨立 HEPA 單元，適合小區域保護、老舊設施改裝和 Commissioning 期間的問題排解
blocks.en: FFUs are a flexible supplementary solution: Self-contained HEPA units with their own fans, suited to protecting small areas, retrofitting older facilities and troubleshooting during commissioning

blocks.zh: 膠封劣化需要積極預防：確保矽膠交聯完全、使用高分子量膠封、減少 DOP/PAO 暴露量。不要用聚氨酯膠替代矽膠。
blocks.en: Gel seal degradation needs active prevention: Ensure the silicone is fully cross-linked, use a high-molecular-weight gel seal, and reduce DOP/PAO exposure. Do not substitute urethane gel for silicone.

blocks.zh: Bleed-through 源自測試條件不匹配：工廠測試（Laskin-nozzle、低風速）與現場測試（hot-block、高風速）條件不同導致。解決方案：在 URS 中明確指定 MPPS 效率和實際測試條件
blocks.en: Bleed-through stems from mismatched test conditions: It is caused by differences between factory testing (Laskin-nozzle, low air velocity) and field testing (hot-block, high air velocity). The solution is to specify the MPPS efficiency and the actual test conditions clearly in the URS

blocks.zh: 無菌保證的決策層級：在所有過濾系統設計決策中，Sterility Assurance（無菌保證）永遠是最優先考量，其次是產品 CQA，最後才是成本與彈性
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy for sterility assurance: In all filtration system design decisions, sterility assurance always comes first, followed by product CQAs, and cost and flexibility come last
